display.purpose: The name in the hero only.

contact-email.purpose: The email address set large on the yellow contact sign.

role-line.purpose: The job title under the name in the hero.

subhead.purpose: Earlier code heading and the mobile menu links.

clock.purpose: Cairo local time on the board.

board-title.purpose: The yellow title of the flight board.

lead.purpose: Board project names and sidebar block headings.

intro.purpose: Hero intro, case summaries, skill group names, the wordmark.

body-arabic.purpose: All Arabic text; taller line height, no negative tracking.

small.purpose: Board cells, notes beside screenshots, the footer.

shadows.name: board
shadows.purpose: Lifts the flight board off the concrete ground.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All state transitions and the flap drop.

motion.name: flap-appear
motion.value: rotateX(90deg) to 0, 420ms, staggered 55ms per row and 30ms per column, doubled on first load
motion.purpose: The one entrance: board cells flip in once.

motion.name: flap-switch
motion.value: fold away 140ms, drop in 260ms, per cell
motion.purpose: Language toggle flips every board cell to the other script.

motion.name: hover-step
motion.value: translateY(-1px) on hover, translateY(1px) on press, 160ms

breakpoints.name: nav-sheet
breakpoints.purpose: Full-screen menu replaces the nav links.

breakpoints.name: board-stacked
breakpoints.purpose: Board rows stack project, role and status beside the year.

narrative.northStar: One career, read like a departures board: scannable in a glance, true in every row, and equally at home in Arabic.
rules: Yellow means go somewhere or you are here; never decoration.
Every lamp carries a written status.
Real screens only, captured from the owner's software on synthetic data.
No eyebrows, gradients, glass, pill clouds or scroll reveals.
